thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches inspire educators and leaders to use technology to create equitable and ongoing access to high-quality learning.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach facilitates a shared vision and culture for technology-enhanced learning; promotes equitable use of digital tools; cultivates a coaching culture of collective ownership; recognises effective educators; and connects the right stakeholders to maximise technology's potential.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach delivers training on tools without building shared vision; does not address equity in technology access; works with individuals without building a culture; and does not connect stakeholders or recognise effective practice.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach addresses individual teacher concerns and shares examples of good practice, but does not facilitate collective vision-building or cultivate a coaching culture where technology serves shared educational goals.

thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches model the ISTE Standards for Students and the ISTE Standards for Educators and identify ways to improve their coaching practice.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach pursues sustained professional learning to deepen expertise in the ISTE Standards; participates in active professional learning networks; and establishes shared goals with educators, reflecting on progress to continuously improve coaching practice.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach draws on existing expertise without sustained learning in the ISTE Standards; is not connected to external professional networks; and does not use shared goals or reflection as tools for improving their own coaching practice.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach attends CPD events and reads about the ISTE Standards, but is not actively embedded in a professional learning community and does not use structured goal-setting and reflection to improve their coaching practice.

thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches establish productive relationships with educators in order to improve instructional practice and learning outcomes.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach builds trusting, respectful coaching relationships; partners to identify culturally relevant and developmentally appropriate digital content; evaluates tool efficacy rigorously; and personalises coaching support to each educator's context.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach delivers a standardised coaching programme without investing in relationship quality; recommends tools based on general reputation rather than contextual relevance; and does not personalise support based on educator needs.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach listens to educator concerns and recommends tools based on subject area, but does not build the trust needed for genuine instructional risk-taking or evaluate tool efficacy against student learning evidence.

thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches model and support educators to design learning experiences and environments to meet the needs and interests of all students.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach co-designs authentic active learning experiences that foster student agency; helps educators build effective digital assessments with timely feedback; designs accessible digital environments for all learners; and models instructional design principles.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach shares existing lesson resources rather than co-designing experiences; does not address accessibility in digital environment design; and does not apply or model instructional design principles with educators.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach co-plans engaging learning experiences and improves assessment design, but does not systematically address accessibility requirements or model the instructional design principles underpinning the choices made.

thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches plan, provide and evaluate the impact of professional learning for educators and leaders to use technology to advance teaching and learning.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach designs professional learning based on robust needs assessment and adult learning frameworks; builds educator capacity to implement the ISTE Standards; and evaluates impact continuously to improve the professional learning programme.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach delivers professional learning based on assumed rather than assessed needs; does not frame sessions in adult learning principles; and evaluates sessions only through immediate satisfaction surveys.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach conducts a pre-session survey and designs interactive CPD, but does not use multi-method needs assessment, does not apply formal adult learning frameworks, and does not measure impact on practice or student outcomes.

thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches model and support the use of qualitative and quantitative data to inform their own instruction and professional learning.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach models secure data collection and analysis practices; supports educators to interpret data critically and triangulate sources; and empowers students to use their own learning data for goal-setting.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach uses data only for reporting purposes; does not model critical data interpretation or security practices; and does not help educators or students use data as an active learning tool.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach runs data-interpretation workshops and helps teachers make instructional adjustments, but does not address data security practices, model how to identify misleading metrics, or extend data use to student-directed goal-setting.

thresholds.standard_source_text: Coaches model digital citizenship and support educators and students in recognizing the responsibilities and opportunities inherent in living in a digital world.
thresholds.met_threshold_description: The coach creates pathways for students to address community challenges with technology; fosters inclusive online spaces and healthy technology balance; supports critical examination of online content and underlying biases; and empowers educators and students to protect personal data and curate intentional digital profiles.
thresholds.not_yet_met_description: The coach treats digital citizenship as a compliance topic; does not create community-facing project opportunities; and does not help educators or students develop critical information literacy or active data management practices.
thresholds.partial_met_description: The coach supports digital citizenship lessons and online safety awareness, but does not design real-world community-connected projects, develop critical source examination skills, or address the practical mechanics of personal data protection.
